title: 💻 Gemini Spark Comes to Mac! A Smart Assistant That Organizes Your Files!
body: 💻 Gemini Spark Comes to Mac! A Smart Assistant That Organizes Your Files!

Google announced at its developer conference its new personal AI assistant, Gemini Spark, and its arrival soon in the Gemini app on Apple Mac computers, giving users of these devices agent capabilities that were previously reserved for Android phones and Windows computers.

The new assistant will be able to organize local files on the device, and extract data from PDF files directly into Google Sheets and Gmail, carrying out multi-step tasks across files, apps, and the web instead of just answering questions.

This step comes amid a fierce race over agentic AI assistants, as ChatGPT, Muse, and Siri all work on moving from answering to acting, and Google seems to want its assistant present even on its rival Apple's devices.
Google has not set an exact date for the update to reach the Mac app, saying only that it will arrive soon, and it has not clarified whether it will reach all users at once or in stages.
Simply put: a smart assistant living inside your Mac, organizing your files and filling your spreadsheets from PDF files on its own… would you trust it with your personal files?
Do you want a smart assistant working inside your computer?
